blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
So far, you have built pages that look good.
But looking good is only half the job.
JavaScript handles the other half. It is what makes a page respond to the person using it. When they click, something reacts. When they scroll, something follows. When they type, something listens.

items: Respond to user actions like clicks, scrolling, and typing
Change content without reloading the page

blocks.content: This is where your website stops being a poster and starts being a product.
Next, let's connect JavaScript to your page.
